NaMiniApp__Meta.NaMiniApp__AppSubTitle: Timed and change triggered image capture from a browser tab

NaMiniApp__UiText.NaMiniApp__Unsupported: This tool needs Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome (version 116 or later) on a desktop computer. Tab capture, the frame reader or the floating window is missing in this browser.
NaMiniApp__UiText.NaMiniApp__NoOverlay: The floating window is not available in this browser. Recording still works: control it from this page.
NaMiniApp__UiText.NaMiniApp__NeedSource: Choose a tab to capture first.
NaMiniApp__UiText.NaMiniApp__NeedFolder: Choose a folder first, or switch Save to Zip download.
NaMiniApp__UiText.NaMiniApp__Dropped: The encoder could not keep up, so an image was skipped. Use a longer interval or JPEG.
NaMiniApp__UiText.NaMiniApp__ZipSaved: Zip saved to your Downloads folder.
NaMiniApp__UiText.NaMiniApp__FolderSaved: Images and CaptureLog.csv written to the folder.
NaMiniApp__UiText.NaMiniApp__FolderError: Could not write to the folder. Check the folder permission.
NaMiniApp__UiText.NaMiniApp__RegionLockedHint: Changing the frame during a run changes the image size for the images after it.
